bio: This restaurant is located right on Wollishofen harbour and boasts a magnificent view of the Zürisee, as the locals call Lake Zurich. The kitchen team, led by David Klocksin, serve up punchy dishes. The four- to five-course surprise menu reflects this with pleasingly pared-down yet full-bodied creations, such as the vegetarian baked cauliflower with curry and peanut. However, the more conventional options, such as the Valais pike-perch or Zurich beef, are just as delectable. A vegetarian version of the set menu is also available. Feel free to add wine or alcohol-free pairings. This is a truly stylish restaurant, where charming and attentive service comes courtesy of Stephanie Ospelt and team. Gorgeous terrace overlooking the lake....
